description: Safety Review of the equal_count_breath normalized candidate. Applies S-B2 and three verdicts to the ingested corpus. Not canon. Canon: docs/practices/PRACTICE_TECHNIQUE_SAFETY_REVIEW_V1.md

bounds.holds: required; identity-bearing from V1.1; not reopened
bounds.timing: count length and whether sides are equal remain common parameters
bounds.effort: sources that mention depth treat it as a local script, not a kernel bound

observed: Light-headedness when breathing more deeply: sitting or lying may help until accustomed.
If attending to the breath is uncomfortable because of breathing-related issues, grounding exercises may be more useful than this breathing leaflet.
not_stop_rules: Marchant methods tell participants not to breathe too deeply and to breathe more shallowly if dizzy. That is an experimental script, not a product stop-rule.
BHF, Newcastle, and CAVUHB write no stop-rules in the ingested sections.

per_evidence.ev.equal_count.bhf.heart_matters.box: Box section does not state who should avoid pausing the breath. observed_safety empty.
per_evidence.ev.equal_count.nhs_sfh.box_leaflet: Stop-rules and redirect are present. They are not a who-must-not-hold population exclusion for a required hold.
per_evidence.ev.equal_count.nhs_newcastle.square: Section does not state who should avoid holding the breath. observed_safety empty.
per_evidence.ev.equal_count.byu.marchant.2025.square: Experimental shallow-if-dizzy instruction is not a general who-must-not-hold bound.
per_evidence.ev.equal_count.nhs_wales.cavuhb.square: Section does not state who should avoid holding the breath. observed_safety empty.

who_must_not_hold.why_sfh_is_not_enough: S-B2: required identity-bearing hold. SFH when-to-stop / sit-lie / grounding redirect does not close who_must_not_hold.

prohibition.why_not_present: No ingested source says the product must not offer this method. SFH publishes the sequence with a later stop heading. Silence on who-must-not is not a ban.

prohibited_claims: treatment or diagnosis of a disorder
guaranteed sleep, calm, money, or relationship outcomes
manifestation of a result by repeating a phrase

why_insufficient_safety: Hold is required. S-B2 therefore needs who_must_not_hold closed before may_release.
All five ingested records leave who_must_not_hold unknown (S-W2).
Stop-rules are present (S-S1) and claim surface is default-closed (S-C1). Those do not complete the required safety surface.
Prohibition is none (S-P0). Unknown is not a ban, so this is not may_not_release.
why_not_may_release: S-B2: SFH stop-rules without who_must_not_hold are not permission to ship a required-hold method.
why_not_may_not_release: S-B2 does not convert missing who-must-not into a prohibition.
No positive evidence that the candidate cannot be released in product bounds.

expression_hypothesis.note: Safety Review does not attest the probe. technique_id remains forbidden.
